hook: On September 22, 2026, the Library of Congress honored Martha C. Nussbaum.

sections.voiceover: On September 22, 2026, the Library of Congress honored Martha C. Nussbaum.
The University of Chicago professor won the John W. Kluge Prize for her study of humanity. What did her philosophy prove about human emotions?
b_roll: Library book shelves and historical texts

sections.voiceover: Nussbaum defended a neo-Stoic account of emotions.
b_roll: Close up of antique philosophy text

sections.voiceover: Martha C. Nussbaum proved emotions are appraisals ascribing great significance to things outside the agent's control. The Library of Congress recognized this breakthrough in 2026. Her groundbreaking work explores how emotions relate to things outside the agent's control.
b_roll: Library of Congress grand reading room
Archival papers on a wooden desk

sections.voiceover: The prestigious 2026 Kluge Prize honors the deepest study of humanity.
